requirement_text: Add Product: Add a product to the system.

l1.code:
structure Mid where
  name : String
  price : Nat
  description : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def ValidateContract : Contract Input Mid where
  pre  := fun i => i.name ≠ "" ∧ 0 < i.price
  post := fun i m => m.name = i.name ∧ m.price = i.price ∧ m.description = i.description

def ComputeContract : Contract Mid Output where
  pre  := fun m => m.name ≠ "" ∧ 0 < m.price
  post := fun m o => o.name = m.name ∧ o.price = m.price ∧ o.description = m.description

theorem po1 : Contract.Compatible ValidateContract ComputeContract := by
  discharge_po [ComputeContract, Spec, ValidateContract]

theorem po2 : Contract.Refines (ValidateContract.seq ComputeContract) Spec := by
  discharge_po [ComputeContract, Spec, ValidateContract]

requirement_text: Remove Product: Remove a product from the system.

l1.code:
structure Mid where
  products : List Product
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def FilterContract : Contract Input Mid where
  pre  := fun i => i.products.Nodup
  post := fun i m => m.products = i.products.filter (fun p => p.name ≠ i.name ∧ p.price ≠ i.price)

def UpdateContract : Contract Mid Output where
  pre  := fun m => m.products.Nodup
  post := fun m o => o.products = m.products

theorem po1 : Contract.Compatible FilterContract UpdateContract := by
  discharge_po [FilterContract, Spec, UpdateContract]

theorem po2 : Contract.Refines (FilterContract.seq UpdateContract) Spec := by
  discharge_po [FilterContract, Spec, UpdateContract]

requirement_text: Update Product Attributes: Update Product attributes within the system.

l1.code:
structure Mid where
  name   : String
  price  : Nat
  stock  : Nat
  rating : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def ValidateContract : Contract Input Mid where
  pre  := fun i => i.name ≠ "" ∧ 0 < i.price ∧ i.stock > 0 ∧ i.rating > 0
  post := fun i m => m.name = i.name ∧
                     m.price = i.price ∧
                     m.stock = i.stock ∧
                     m.rating = i.rating

def ComputeContract : Contract Mid Output where
  pre  := fun m => m.name ≠ "" ∧ 0 < m.price ∧ m.stock > 0 ∧ m.rating > 0
  post := fun m o => o.name = m.name ∧
                     o.price = m.price ∧
                     o.stock = m.stock ∧
                     o.rating = m.rating

theorem po1 : Contract.Compatible ValidateContract ComputeContract := by
  discharge_po [ComputeContract, Spec, ValidateContract]

theorem po2 : Contract.Refines (ValidateContract.seq ComputeContract) Spec := by
  discharge_po [ComputeContract, Spec, ValidateContract]
